description: This file contains utility functions for handling JSON data. It includes functions for normalizing data to arrays, safely parsing JSON strings into arrays, and detecting data field types (numeric or categorical) based on sample data.

methods.name: normalizeToArray(data)
methods.description: Normalizes input data to an array, handling cases where data might be nested within 'items' or 'data' properties.

methods.name: safeParseJsonArray(text)
methods.description: Parses a JSON string safely into an array of records, throwing a descriptive error if parsing fails or the result is not an array.

methods.name: detectFieldTypes(rows)
methods.description: Samples dataset rows to identify which fields are predominantly numeric or categorical.
